drafted: The CSV is served at `POST /requisitions.csv` with the requisitions as a JSON array body; the answer is 200 with `text/csv; charset=utf-8` and `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="requisitions.csv"`.
`createdAt` is an ISO 8601 time with seconds and `Z` or an offset; anything else, or a time that does not exist, is invalid; the date written is the UTC date.
Rows are ordered by creation time, then by id compared as strings.
A bad requisition is a 422 with a JSON body naming the first bad requisition's id in request order; nothing of the CSV is sent.
A body that is not an array of objects with a string `id` is a 400 with a JSON `error`.
Other methods on the path are 405 with `Allow: POST`; other paths 404.
The quoting rule applies to every field, the id included; the formula rule to the title only.
